rules: docs/AUDIT.md §6 (fixed before training); see this script's docstring

A.label: class-weighted loss
A.threshold_rule: lowest calibrated confidence with out-of-fold accuracy on answered photos >= 90% (coverage of in-scope photos >= 50%)

B.label: class-balanced sampling
B.threshold_rule: lowest calibrated confidence with out-of-fold accuracy on answered photos >= 90% (coverage of in-scope photos >= 50%)

E.label: leaf crop + class-balanced sampling
E.threshold_rule: lowest calibrated confidence with out-of-fold accuracy on answered photos >= 90% (coverage of in-scope photos >= 50%)

chosen.why: macro-F1 within 0.01 of the best (B, E): lowest out-of-fold NLL
